findings.detail: EUR par/principal symbols were propagated into cost_currency even though the investment schedule cost and fair value columns are USD valuation columns.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The raw schedule has EUR-denominated par/principal rows, but those rows sit under Cost (27) and Fair Value (1)(28) valuation columns that roll to dollar-denominated investment totals. The extracted cost_currency U_EUR therefore reflects propagation of the par currency into the cost valuation field, not the source valuation currency.
